name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. I fetched the quickstart page, installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), and wrote a Python script following the documented pattern. The exact model string in the docs (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 NOT_FOUND, so I listed available chat models via the API and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731`. The script then successfully returned a chat completion from the Fireworks API (e.g., "Hola" and a fuller Spanish greeting). The promised outcome is verified.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned 404 NOT_FOUND. I queried the models endpoint to find an accessible chat model and used `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` instead. This is the only deviation from the documented instructions.

first_call.evidence: First python3 quickstart.py run raised openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}...

verified.evidence: Final python3 quickstart.py run printed Hello in Spanish is **Hola** (pronounced *OH-lah*). with exit=0
